title: TWO TEAMMATES DOWN ARE TWO ALERTS
why: In a party of three or four, a second teammate going down said TEAMMATE DOWN while the first one still showed, and because the alert lane matched an alert by its headline alone it refreshed the first in place: the detail became REVIVE and the second name, and the first man down vanished from the screen while he still lay there. An alert with a key of its own is now a new alert even with the same headline, so the second takes the slot and the first waits in the alert queue and comes back. Alerts with the same key, or no key, refresh exactly as before.
now: With two teammates down, each one keeps a TEAMMATE DOWN alert.
